# Terrakube

> Open source infrastructure as code automation and collaboration for Terraform and OpenTofu. Self-hosted on Kubernetes (Helm) or Docker Compose. Terraform and OpenTofu connect to it as a remote backend.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://docs.terrakube.io/getting-started/getting-started)
- [Deployment](https://docs.terrakube.io/getting-started/deployment)
- [User management and SSO](https://docs.terrakube.io/getting-started/user-management)
- [Creating workspaces](https://docs.terrakube.io/run-terraform/workspaces/creating-workspaces)
- [CLI-driven workflow](https://docs.terrakube.io/run-terraform/workspaces/cli-driven-workflow)
- [API-driven workflow](https://docs.terrakube.io/run-terraform/workspaces/api-driven-workflow)
- [Templates](https://docs.terrakube.io/set-up/organizations/templates)
- [Run triggers](https://docs.terrakube.io/run-terraform/workspaces/run-triggers)
- [Policy governance (OPA)](https://docs.terrakube.io/govern/policy-enforcement-opa)
- [Private registry](https://docs.terrakube.io/private-registry/private-registry)
- [Terrakube CLI](https://docs.terrakube.io/integrate/terrakube-cli)
